sources.title: GLM-4.6V-Flash: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview GLM-4.6V-Flash is a 9-billion-parameter multimodal vision-language model designed for local deployment and low-latency inference, developed by zai-org. Part of the GLM-V family introduced in the paper on scalable reinforcement learning for multimodal reasoning, this model processes interleaved image-text inputs and generates text outputs with native function calling capabilities.
